name: Microsoft Teams (macOS)
description: Optimized for Microsoft Teams on macOS - standard window sharing settings
explanation: Microsoft Teams on macOS uses CGWindowList APIs for screen sharing detection. Normal window level (macos_floating_level=false) ensures the window appears in standard window lists. Participating in the window cycle (macos_participates_in_cycle=true) makes it visible in Mission Control and screen capture pickers. Sharing type 1 ensures Teams can access the window through ScreenCaptureKit.
